notes.title: Bug Fixes and Game Over Screen!
notes.notes: Introducing a brand new Game Over screen and a dynamic game over sound effect to enhance your Monkey Party experience! We've also been hard at work addressing various bugs based on your invaluable feedback. Your input matters to us, and we're committed to making Monkey Party the best it can be! Now, the Game Over screen displays your score for that round, your high score, and even the current world record, so you can track your progress like never before!
